$comment: Conformance fixture for the OLD six-group Activity table (needs-you,
Desktop, the web client and ADE Code no longer group by it: every Activity
surface now counts by the Work board's four columns, pinned by
activityBoardColumn.cases.json beside this file. The table survives only
because the push relay still fills the Live Activity's `groups` field from
it, for iOS builds that predate the four-column Live Activity. The relay
and the relay and iOS suites are the ones that run these cases. Delete this
file when the relay stops sending `groups`.
`chatActivityMode` is the optional additive field; null means absent.

cases.name: idle tier outranks every phase, including a raised hand
idle tier demotes a failure too, not only needs-you
idle tier demotes a running turn
needs_you is the amber band
failed is its own band, never amber
checks_failing files with failed
changes_requested files with failed
a running turn is working when no chat activity mode is carried
planning comes from chatActivityMode, never from a phase
a starting turn can be planning too
starting without a mode is working
planning only applies to a live turn, not to a raised hand
stale is its own idle band -- neither working nor done
an open pull request is live-band
review_requested is someone else's move, so live-band not amber
merge_ready is live-band -- NOT done (the iOS copy drifted here)
blocked is live-band
completed is the ambient tail
merged is the ambient tail
closed is the ambient tail
an unrecognized mode value is not planning
an idle-tier row is idle, never done -- done means finished
a genuinely completed run at ambient tier is still done
planning cannot survive going stale
